selection: Every complete admission from the published anchor through latest admission also present in the stable retained summary prefix; one later complete admission excluded pending its matching summary. No outcome selection or deduplication.
field_mapping: Candidate, previous-best, retained-best utility, acceptance and best-round identity are logged fields. Decision tag is derived from logged acceptance and exact Decimal candidate-minus-prior-best utility.
source_binding: Aggregate field interpretation only; exact installed source, adapter and evaluation population remain unjoined
scope: Adaptive development admissions; independent first-proposal and deployment evaluation remain required
